types.name: CollisionBounds
types.doc: Axis-aligned bounds after a shape pose, with a conservative radius about its origin.

fields.name: corners
fields.doc: Eight conservative corners, using the same bounds as placement and motion queries.

types.name: CollisionBuild
types.doc:
A `CollisionDescription` built into a world: the world's id of every
described body and object, how many pairs overlapped at their
articulation's reference, and the layout errors: pairs colliding at the
reference between an articulation and anything outside it (CL-D3).

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Live geometry and policy after transfers; the original build input remains reusable.

fields.name: transferBody
fields.doc:
Change a carried body's frame without moving its shapes in the world.
Geometry, inflation and object ids remain unchanged. This is the same
operation for a grasp, a placement, and a transfer between carriers.

fields.name: restoreBodyRule
fields.doc: Restore an authored rule after a temporary process window.

fields.name: openContactWindow
fields.doc: A temporary contact window overrides object rules as well as body rules.

fields.name: closeContactWindow
fields.doc: Restore the live description's policy after a contact window closes.

fields.name: openObjectWindow
fields.doc: A window between two sets of described objects: contact allowed (no margin) or the margin between them.

fields.name: closeObjectWindow
fields.doc: Restore the described rules and margins between two sets of objects.

fields.name: objectOf
fields.doc: The described object a world object came from, or -1.

fields.name: bodyOf
fields.doc: The described body a world body came from, or -1 (the world).

types.name: CollisionDescription
types.doc:
A cell's collision description (COLLISION.md CL3): bodies with their
groups and poses, shapes on them, rules with their reasons, the
articulations and their reference configurations, and the assumptions the
geometry makes (CL-D8). Geometry sources (RobotKit, CadKit through
cadbridge, terrain) add to it; `build` turns it into a `CollisionWorld`.
It is plain data, so the same description can feed other consumers (the
simulation, CL3b).

fields.name: margins
fields.doc: Air and process margins belong to the same description as its pair rules.

fields.name: assumptions
fields.doc: What the geometry approximates or ignores, once each, in the order noted.

fields.name: append
fields.doc: Appends another scene, remapping its body/object references and rules.

fields.name: addBody
fields.doc: Adds a body; `pose` is where it starts (an articulation's bodies start at its reference).

fields.name: addObject
fields.doc: Adds a shape on `body` (-1: the world) at `offset`; `source` says what it approximates.

fields.name: addFixed
fields.doc: Adds a fixed body at `pose` with one shape on it; returns the object.

fields.name: restoreBodyPolicy
fields.doc: Release restores authored seat/contact policy instead of a carried part's exclusions.

fields.name: setHeldContacts
fields.doc: Carried stock checks every outside shape except its explicitly named contact surfaces.

fields.name: setObjectMargins
fields.doc: Exact object-pair margins do not alter any other object in the same margin class.

fields.name: applyObjectMargins
fields.doc: Restore only this described pair's sparse margins, without rewriting the class table.

fields.name: setGroupMargins
fields.doc: Margin classes are explicit groups, shared by as many objects as belong to that class.

fields.name: addArticulation
fields.doc: Declares an articulation: its bodies, posed at the named reference configuration.

fields.name: bodyRadius
fields.doc:
The radius of a body's objects about its frame: no point of them is
farther from the body's origin (inflation included). Motion bounds use
it (CL-D5). Height fields and half-spaces have no finite radius.

fields.name: note
fields.doc: Records an assumption once.

fields.name: build
fields.doc:
Adds everything to `world`, poses each body where the description has
it, marks each articulation's overlaps at its reference, and reports as
layout errors the pairs colliding there between an articulation's body
and anything outside it. The world is left posed at the references.

types.name: CollisionDistance
types.doc:
A pair's closest approach in world coordinates: the objects and their
bodies (-1: the world), the signed distance (negative when penetrating),
the closest point on each object (x, y, z), and the unit normal from `a`
toward `b`.

fields.name: new
fields.signature: (a:Int, b:Int, bodyA:Int, bodyB:Int, distance:Float, pointA:Array<Float>, pointB:Array<Float>, normal:Array<Float>):Void

types.name: CollisionGeometry
types.doc:
A collision shape, in its body's frame after the offset it is added with
(COLLISION.md CL-D1). Lengths are in the caller's unit; axial shapes run
along local z. Primitives and convex sets can be inflated
(`CollisionWorld.setInflation`); meshes are surfaces (CL-D8).

fields.name: Capsule
fields.doc: A segment of length 2·halfLength along z, swept by a sphere.

fields.name: HalfSpace
fields.doc: The solid side of a plane: n·p ≤ offset.

fields.name: Convex
fields.doc: The convex hull of points (x, y, z each; four or more, not coplanar). Pass the hull's vertices.

fields.name: Mesh
fields.doc: A triangle mesh: vertices x, y, z each, three indices per triangle.

fields.name: HeightField
fields.doc:
A grid of `rows` x (heights.length / rows) heights, row-major, centred on
the offset over xSize by ySize; columns run along +x, rows along -y. A
solid down to `minHeight`; no height may be below it (CL-D6).

types.name: CollisionMarginClass
types.doc: Cell margin classes; exact process-interface margins are sparse object-pair overrides.

types.name: CollisionMargins
types.doc:
The clearance required between bodies, per pair of body groups (CL-D4's
pair classes: a robot's links, its tool, held parts, the environment).
Groups are numbered from 0; every pair starts at `initial`.

fields.name: ceiling
fields.doc: Optional upper bound also applies to sparse object-pair margins.

fields.name: uniform
fields.doc: One margin for every pair.

fields.name: flat
fields.doc: The square table, row-major (as `collisionkit.h` reads it).

types.name: CollisionPair
types.doc: Two collision objects, the lower id first, with the bodies they are on (-1: the world).

types.name: CollisionPairRule
types.doc: A declared rule for a pair of bodies or of objects.

fields.name: Default
fields.doc: No declared rule: the pair's status follows the defaults.

fields.name: Allow
fields.doc: Not checked, for a reason (`CollisionPairStatus`).

fields.name: Check
fields.doc: Checked even where the defaults would not check it.

fields.name: Touch
fields.doc: Checked; at zero margin, touching is permitted but penetration beyond numerical precision is not.

types.name: CollisionPairStatus
types.doc:
Whether a pair of collision objects is checked, and why not
(COLLISION.md CL-D3). An allow rule records one of the reasons here.

fields.name: Static
fields.doc: Both bodies are static (fixed in this cell; the world is).

fields.name: Rigid
fields.doc: They never move relative to each other: one body, or bodies joined only through fixed joints.

fields.name: Adjacent
fields.doc: Their bodies are one movable joint apart.

fields.name: OverlapsAtReference
fields.doc: They overlapped at their articulation's reference configuration (`CollisionWorld.allowOverlapping`).

fields.name: Allowed
fields.doc: Allowed by a declared rule.

fields.name: Unsupported
fields.doc: Would be checked, but the shapes cannot be compared: queries fail until it is allowed or removed.

fields.name: Closure
fields.doc: Joined by a closure of the caller's model.

fields.name: ProcessContact
fields.doc: Process contact (a torch on its seam), allowed per window (CL-D9).

fields.name: DeclaredContact
fields.doc: Meant to touch: RobotKit's contact pairs (CL-D10).

types.name: CollisionPose
types.doc:
A rigid transform: a translation and a unit quaternion (x, y, z, w), in
the world's frame for a body, in its body's frame for an object's offset.
Callers convert their own transforms (a kit snapshot's body poses,
RobotKit's `Transform3`) to it.

fields.name: new
fields.signature: (x:Float, y:Float, z:Float, qx:Float, qy:Float, qz:Float, qw:Float):Void

fields.name: writeTo
fields.doc: Appends the seven numbers to `out`.

types.name: CollisionViolation
types.doc:
A checked pair closer than its query required (or, from `closest`, the
closest pair): the objects, their bodies (-1: the world), the signed
distance, and the clearance required (the group margin plus both bodies'
inflation). `set` is the index of the pose set it was found in, for
batched queries (0 otherwise).

fields.name: new
fields.signature: (a:Int, b:Int, bodyA:Int, bodyB:Int, distance:Float, required:Float, set:Int):Void

types.name: CollisionWorld
types.doc:
Collision objects attached to bodies the caller registers and poses
(COLLISION.md CL-D1, CL-D2). The world knows bodies, not models: one
world holds a whole cell (several robots and mechanisms, each the
caller's own model, and the environment). Body -1 is the world itself.
Bodies are numbered from 0 in the order they are added; object ids are
never reused.

Only `Checked` pairs are queried (`CollisionPairStatus` says why others
are not). A checked pair whose shapes cannot be compared makes queries
throw: a check is never silently skipped.

`collisionkit.native.NativeCollisionWorld` (collisionkit-native, on coal)
implements it. Without a backend nothing does: callers report collision
as unchecked, never as passed.

fields.name: addBody
fields.doc: Adds a body in `group` (CL-D4's pair classes, from 0), at the identity and not static; returns its number.

fields.name: setBodyStatic
fields.doc: A static body is fixed in this cell: pairs between static bodies are never checked.

fields.name: setBodyPoses
fields.doc: Poses bodies `first`, `first + 1`, ... from seven numbers each (x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw).

fields.name: add
fields.doc: Adds a shape on `body` (-1: the world) at `offset` in the body's frame; returns its id.

fields.name: setInflation
fields.doc: Inflates a primitive or convex object by `radius`: every distance to it shrinks by that much.

fields.name: setHeights
fields.doc: Replaces a height field's heights (the same grid, none below its minimum), e.g. after digging.

fields.name: attach
fields.doc: Moves an object onto `body` (-1: the world) at `offset`: a grasped or placed part. It follows the new body's rules.

fields.name: setBodyRule
fields.doc: A rule for every object pair between two bodies; `reason` is what an allow rule records.

fields.name: setObjectRule
fields.doc: A rule for one object pair (process contact); it overrides body rules.

fields.name: setObjectMargins
fields.doc: Sparse object-pair margins override group classes; null restores the class margin.

fields.name: allowOverlapping
fields.doc:
Over `bodies` (one articulation, posed at its reference configuration),
marks the object pairs colliding now as `OverlapsAtReference`, replacing
earlier marks among them. Pairs reaching outside the set stay checked:
an overlap with the environment is a layout error. Returns how many.

fields.name: colliding
fields.doc:
Checked pairs closer than `margin` (0: touching or penetrating), in id order.
Explicit Touch rules permit zero-margin contact, but still reject penetration beyond numerical precision.

fields.name: distances
fields.doc: Checked pairs closer than `queryDistance`, closest first.

fields.name: pairDistances
fields.doc: The distances of chosen pairs, whatever their status, each as given (`a` first).

fields.name: violation
fields.doc:
The first checked pair, in id order, closer than its group margin plus
both bodies' motion bounds in `inflation` (one per body; null for none), or null.
Shapes on one body have no relative motion and retain only their group margin.
Geometric object inflation still applies.

fields.name: closest
fields.doc: The closest checked pair, clear or not, with its group margin as `required`; null when none is checked.

fields.name: firstViolation
fields.doc:
Batched violations: `poses` holds sets of every body's pose (seven
numbers per body), `inflation` one number per body per set (or null).
The first set with a violation reports it, with `set` its index; null
when every set is clear. The world is left posed at the last set checked.

fields.name: violations
fields.doc: As `firstViolation`, but for every set: true where the set has a violation (a planner's edge checks, CL-D7).

types.name: ConvexDecomposer
types.doc:
Splits a closed triangle mesh into convex pieces whose union, inflated by
the decomposition's `inflation`, encloses it (CL-D11).
`collisionkit.native.NativeConvexDecomposer` implements it with V-HACD 4.

fields.name: decompose
fields.doc:
`vertices` x, y, z each, `indices` three per triangle; at most
`maxPieces` pieces; `sampleSpacing` 0 picks 0.5 % of the bounding
diagonal.

types.name: ConvexDecomposition
types.doc:
A mesh split into convex pieces (CL-D11): each piece's vertices (x, y, z
each), and the inflation after which their union encloses the mesh:
`measured` (the farthest a sample of the mesh lies outside every piece)
plus `spacing` (no point of the mesh is farther than that from a sample).

types.name: DescribedArticulation
types.doc:
One articulation of a `CollisionDescription` (a robot, a CAD mechanism):
its bodies, and the reference configuration they are posed at when the
description is built (CL-D3: overlap at reference applies among them).

fields.name: reference
fields.doc: What the reference configuration is ("home", "zero", or the caller's name).

types.name: DescribedBody
types.doc: A body of a `CollisionDescription`: its name, pair-class group (CL-D4), whether it is fixed in the cell, and its pose.

types.name: DescribedObject
types.doc:
A shape of a `CollisionDescription` on a body (-1: the world), at an
offset in the body's frame, with its inflation and what it approximates
(`source`, e.g. "primitive", "hull", "enclosing hull", "surface mesh",
"decomposed piece"), for the report's assumptions (CL-D8).

fields.name: member
fields.doc: Physical source member shared by all of its convex pieces; never inferred from the display name.

fields.name: tool
fields.doc: Tool identity is independent of margin classes and carrier ownership.

types.name: DescribedRule
types.doc: A declared rule between two bodies (-1: the world) or two objects of a `CollisionDescription`, with its reason.

types.name: ModelBodies
types.doc:
A `KinematicModel`'s bodies in a `CollisionDescription` (CL-D1, CL-D3):
one described body per model body, the kit's rigid, adjacent and closure
pairs as rules, posed at a reference configuration and declared as one
articulation. Extra bodies can follow a model body rigidly (a tool in its
own group); they take that body's rules. `place` poses them all from a
snapshot of the model.

fields.name: bodies
fields.doc: Described body of each model body.

fields.name: followers
fields.doc: Described bodies that follow a model body, and the model body each follows.

fields.name: bind
fields.doc:
Bind authored link-named bodies without replacing their geometry. The
model's rigid, adjacent and closure pairs become rules, as in
`describe`, and a second body on one link follows it, as in `follow`.
A rule the description already authors for a pair is kept.

fields.name: describe
fields.signature: (description:CollisionDescription, model:KinematicModel, name:String, group:Int, reference:KinematicState, referenceName:String, fixedRoots:Bool):ModelBodies
fields.doc:
Adds `model`'s bodies to `description` in `group`, named
`name/bodyId`, posed at `reference` (called `referenceName`). With
`fixedRoots`, bodies rigid to a root of the model are fixed in the cell
(a robot bolted down); otherwise only the model's structure decides.

fields.name: follow
fields.doc:
Adds a body in `group` that moves rigidly with model body `body` (a tool
on its flange link): it is rigid with that body and takes its rules.

fields.name: carry
fields.doc: Carried stock follows the pose without inheriting structural contact exemptions.

fields.name: declare
fields.doc: Declares the bodies (and followers) as one articulation at the reference; call once all followers exist.

fields.name: all
fields.doc: Every described body of this model, followers last.

fields.name: copyForDescription
fields.doc: An independently mutable mapping for a world's live copy of the description.

fields.name: carrier
fields.doc: Model body followed by a described body, or -1 for independent geometry.

fields.name: transfer
fields.signature: (build:CollisionBuild, body:Int, current:CollisionPose, target:CollisionPose, fixed:Bool, carrier:Int, contacts:Array<Int>, ?releasedPolicy:CollisionDescription):Void
fields.doc: Transfer collision geometry and its mechanical follower together.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: A state of the model at DOF values `q`, with the root poses of the reference (where the model sits in the cell).

fields.name: stateInto
fields.doc: Update caller-owned scratch, including the reference's current root poses.

fields.name: place
fields.doc: Poses the built world's bodies of this model for `state` (its root poses included: see `state`).

fields.name: poses
fields.doc: Every body's pose for `state` (seven numbers each, in `all()` order): a pose set for batched checks.

fields.name: posesInto
fields.doc: Write a batch pose set into caller-owned storage without allocating another array.

fields.name: avoidancePairs
fields.doc:
Avoidance pairs for this model (COLLISION.md CL5) from a built world's
distances: each pair with a body of this model, as model bodies (a side
outside it, or a follower such as the tool, maps to its model body or
-1), with the pair's safety margin and influence distance.

types.name: NativeCollisionWorld
types.doc:
A `CollisionWorld` on coal, through collisionkit's C ABI (`ck_*`, see
`collisionkit.h`). Owns the native handle; call `dispose` when done.

types.name: NativeConvexDecomposer
types.doc: V-HACD 4 through collisionkit's C ABI (`ck_decompose`), with the enclosure measured natively (CL-D11).

fields.name: resolution
fields.doc: V-HACD's voxel resolution.
